title: The Third Shot
style: fast beat, heavy phonk, big band brass, female lead vocal, call and response, coaching spoken word, driving groove, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[Intro]

(spoken)

Serve. Return.

The third shot changes everything.

[Verse 1]

Serve lands deep, return comes back strong

You're mid court now, where do you belong

Don't drive it hard, drop it soft instead

Open face, high arc, let it float ahead

Short backswing, contact out in front

Brush up and through, feel the gentle punt

High over the net, lands in the zone

Now walk in steady, claim what you own

[Pre-Chorus]

The third shot is the reset key

It breaks their pressure, it sets you free

Drive it back and they attack

DROP IT SOFT AND WALK IN ON TRACK

[Chorus]

THE THIRD SHOT DROP

RESETS THE WHOLE RALLY

THE THIRD SHOT DROP

GETS YOU TO THE NET

THE THIRD SHOT DROP

PATIENCE IS THE WEAPON

THE THIRD SHOT DROP

DON'T RUSH IT, NOT YET

[Verse 2]

From the baseline the arc needs height

Clear the net with room, keep it light

Move in behind the shot while it lands

Split step ready, court in your hands

They have to lift it if the drop is right

Now you're at the kitchen, own the night

Reset the rally with one soft stroke

The third shot drop is how champions spoke

[Bridge]

(spoken)

If your drop is good, it forces a soft reply.

That gives you time to move in.

Move in and you own the kitchen.

Own the kitchen and you control the point.

Short backswing. Open face. High arc. Soft landing.

That is the third shot drop.

[Final Chorus]

THE THIRD SHOT DROP

RESETS THE WHOLE RALLY

THE THIRD SHOT DROP

GETS YOU TO THE NET

THE THIRD SHOT DROP

PATIENCE IS THE WEAPON

THE THIRD SHOT DROP

SOFT HANDS, NO REGRET

[Outro]

(spoken)

Serve. Return.

Drop it soft.

Walk in.

Own the kitchen.

Every time.
